items.condition: Using author fitted curves/time constants as independent measured rows, confusing solution with PMMA, treating pixel bounds as measured noise or applying unverified beam calibration invalidates dependent inference.

Fabricated or absent artifacts, unrelated raw runs, unresolvable object/record/quantity links, mismatched hashes or failed computations presented as completed evidence. A declared bounded failure is reportable but is not a complete answer.

Copied author numbers or a legacy scalar without evidence supporting the current question; prose-only mechanisms; missing necessary evidence hidden behind an unresolved label. Do not fail a valid alternative route merely for omitting a reference operation.

Do not claim a unique instantaneous/thermal fraction, intrinsic electronic susceptibility or optical-limiter performance from ring counts alone. Unmeasured calibration cannot be silently fixed to author-fit values. A completed observational analysis may establish non-identifiability; simply asserting missing data is a bounded failure, not completed research.
